verdict.rationale: The Radeon RX 9070 XT is GPU hardware with driver and compute software, so built-in AI-generated insights from a user's own data is a category error for this product type. The evidence shows ROCm support for running frameworks such as vLLM and Llama.cpp, but those are developer building blocks that host other people's AI applications, not an in-product insights feature. The "performance reports" in AMD Software are not described as AI-generated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
